_comment_security: PUBLIC APP STORE BUILD. The bundled PWA is served from capacitor://localhost; there is NO server.url. First-run pairing stores the user's own Mac host (Tailscale IP, MagicDNS, or any reachable hostname) in @capacitor/preferences, and every WebSocket + REST call targets that stored host. The remote connection to the user's Mac is HTTP on their Tailnet (cleartext at the socket level, wrapped in WireGuard by Tailscale per RELEASING-IOS.md). ATS exceptions in Info.plist still permit HTTP under *.ts.net, which is the only transport we document today. See RELEASING-IOS.md 'Follow-up PR' and 'App Store submission'.
